description: For equality-free \(B,D\), assuming replacements below the depth of \(B\lor D\), a supplied cut-free producer of \(\Gamma\Rightarrow B\lor D\) and both continuations \(\Gamma,B\Rightarrow C\), \(\Gamma,D\Rightarrow C\) give an actual cut-free tree of \(\Gamma\Rightarrow C\), uniformly across protected name extensions.
